observation_age_minutes.meaning: age of the most recent pool observation at the time the owner liquidity operation is evaluated

observation_history_insufficient.meaning: pool has insufficient observation history for the TWAP query (newly deployed pool)

owner_liquidity_tx_pending.meaning: an owner-initiated liquidity operation transaction targeting the pool is pending in the mempool

attacker_capital_available.meaning: attacker has flash loan capital for price manipulation plus gas costs available

rebalance_gas_cost_incurred.meaning: gas costs are required to rebalance the mispositioned liquidity back into productive range
rebalance_gas_cost_incurred.checkpoint: after owner liquidity operation executes and position is out-of-range at true price

rebalance_gas_cost_required.meaning: the mispositioned position requires an operational rebalance whose gas cost is borne by the protocol/owner
rebalance_gas_cost_required.checkpoint: after owner liquidity operation executes and position is out-of-range at true price

assumptions: The owner liquidity operation is a mint/rebalance that derives tick ranges from the pool price returned by checkPoolAndGetCenterPrice.
The attacker front-runs with a large swap and back-runs to restore the true price, so the position is centered on the manipulated price.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the owner transaction is a mint, rebalance, or other liquidity operation, nor numeric bounds for the swap size or tick shifts.
The gas cost to rebalance is described only qualitatively; no numeric amount, rate, or threshold is given, so it is represented as Boolean cost-occurrence observables rather than a numeric bound.

limitations: Formalizes only the gas-cost-to-rebalance impact; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
The scenario is described conditionally/potentially; the plan encodes the report-supported conditional scenario, not an observed transaction.
The rebalance gas cost is a Boolean occurrence because the report supplies no numeric magnitude or rate.
